events.did: shot ice out of her fingers and up June’s wrist and arm, then tore free herself
events.quote_anchor: “Nice try,” said Serena, as ice shot out from her fingers, and up June’s wrist, over her arm. She tore free, dancing backward.

events.did: reached out, steadied June, drew her in and drove the knife between her ribs
events.quote_anchor: if Serena hadn’t reached out and steadied her, drawn her in, and driven the knife between her ribs.

events.did: stepped backward, dragging her body off the knife, and changed shells
events.quote_anchor: She stepped backward, dragging her body off the knife, and as she did, she changed, shrugging out of one shell, and donning another

events.did: tipped her head and turned the weapon June held into a wilted tulip
events.quote_anchor: “Is it?” Serena tipped her head, and the weapon changed, became a wilted tulip.

events.did: twitched her fingers so the tulip stem snapped with a deafening BANG
events.quote_anchor: Her fingers twitched, and the tulip stem snapped, with a deafening BANG.

events.did: flicked her wrist so the ice shot up in sharpened spikes that drove through June
events.quote_anchor: She flicked her wrist, and instead of giving way, the ice shot up in sharpened spikes.

events.did: reached through Mitch’s body, past it, for the thread
events.quote_anchor: Her fingers splayed on Mitch’s chest as she reached, through his body, past it, for the thread.

events.did: whipped her knife through the air and buried it in June’s real heart
events.quote_anchor: In that same moment, Serena whipped her knife through the air.

relations.did: Serena did not know what June was or what she could do
relations.quote_anchor: She didn’t know what she was, what she could do.

relations.did: it was Serena’s world, her dream, and every inch of it was under her control
relations.quote_anchor: this was Serena’s world. Her dream. And every inch of it was under her control.

relations.did: Sydney told Mitch it was okay and that she could fix it
relations.quote_anchor: “It’s okay,” she said, to him, and to herself. “I can fix it now.”

relations.did: Sydney was seeing the EO as she had been once, back when she was human
relations.quote_anchor: Sydney realized it wasn’t a shell at all. Sydney was seeing the EO as she had been once, back when she was human.

numbers.did: how many shells she shrugged out of: one (原文: one shell)
numbers.quote_anchor: shrugging out of one shell, and donning another in the time it took Serena’s amusement to die on her face.

numbers.did: which shot she tried to fire: a second shot (原文: a second shot)
numbers.quote_anchor: June tried to fire a second shot but lost her balance when the ice broke suddenly beneath her feet.

numbers.who: the young woman Sydney had never seen before
numbers.did: how many of them there was: One (原文: One)
numbers.quote_anchor: One with auburn hair and fair, freckled skin, sharp green eyes in a heart-shaped face.

numbers.did: what came first in her thought about June’s features: her first thought (原文: first)
numbers.quote_anchor: Syd’s first thought was that the features suited her. They matched her manner and her voice.
